setting_b_requirement: At week t the method must condition on all arrived labels through t-1 and only 42 of 52 current outputs, then predict the 10 current hidden outputs.

evidence.finding: The official trainer passes every time point with its complete output vector Y_train.T to tf.data.Dataset.
The official trainer has the same complete-vector interface Y_train.T and no observation mask argument.

correction: Complete historical vectors are compatible with the delayed Setting B protocol. LMC-SVGP and IMC-SVGP now use a thin official-core adapter followed by analytic conditioning of the full-output predictive Gaussian. FSDE-SVI exposes the same full covariance through FSDE_SVI.predict and is audited separately in fsde_svi_setting_b_gate.json.
reporting_rule: This file no longer governs LMC-SVGP, IMC-SVGP or FSDE-SVI eligibility. It remains as provenance for the original API audit; the current catalogue records each method's completed or runtime-limited state.
